The #PactForTheFuture has been adopted, positioning energy access and security as essential for economic development, social stability, and achieving our Development Goals. It calls for urgent action to mobilize finance at scale to ensure affordable, reliable, and sustainable energy for all, alongside investments in resilient cross-border energy infrastructure.

Unlocking the scale of private investment in clean energy will require policy de-risking mechanisms to enhance the financial viability of renewable projects, incentivizing private capital, affordable tariffs, and expanded energy services. Given that 40% of low- and middle-income countries are facing severe debt issues, targeted financial flows and equitable redistribution are essential for accelerating renewable energy deployment in the Global South.

#Digital, AI, and data hold immense potential to meet these goals by guiding financing towards impactful solutions through data-driven insights.

Learn about the actionable steps to ensure that #OurCommonFuture leverages #digital to accelerate the finance needed to drive progress for our energy, climate, and development goals. 🌱💡 👉 bit.ly/SEH-Energy-Digital
